description.en:
The alert notification method. Valid values:

<props="china">- SMS: text message.</props>

<props="china">- AliIM: TradeManager.</props>

- Mail: email.

- DingWebHook: DingTalk chatbot.

description.zh:
报警类型的值。

description.en:
The value of the alert notification method.

> This parameter is required only when `ChanelType` is set to `Mail`.
The name of the alert contact.

The current page number.

Default value: 1.

description.zh:
每页显示的记录条数。

默认值：100。
description.en:
The number of entries per page.

Default value: 100.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms describe-contact-list --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --contact-name Alice --chanel-type Mail --chanel-value Alice@example.com --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
